## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `8e055464efa15842ec992e8cd6316f5c6c35f193`
Local-runs: none
Scope: `ui/packages/components/src/custom/view-skeleton.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/shimmer-skeleton.tsx`, `ui/packages/components/src/custom/index.ts`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/styles.css` + `ui/packages/components/package.json` (the `exports` map), `ui/packages/components/src/index.ts` (the barrel), `ui/packages/components/src/__tests__/chart-primitives-removed-7397.test.ts`, `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/DatasetWidget.tsx` and `ui/packages/plugin-charts/src/ObjectChart.tsx` (the live `GridSkeleton` / `ChartSkeleton` importers), `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`, `AGENTS.md` Post-Task Checklist step 3 and `docs/adr/0087-metadata-protocol-upgrade-contract.md` (the `runtime-export-retired` category), `docs/adr/0145-ui-deprecation-tombstones-retire-on-the-spec-window.md`. The changeset `.changeset/25915-retire-view-and-shimmer-skeleton.md` is the prose face: read for ②, not reviewed. Inputs: card #25915 body and all 15 comments (ruling B 6486367718, dispatch order 6486381447, claim 6486419404, amendment 6487017457, dev reports 6487003112 and 6488314437), PR #27388 body, file list, both PR comments, the net diff against `main` at the head, and the 60 check-runs on the head. Read with `git show prr-27388:...` and `git grep` on `prr-27388` and `origin/main` (45c9be5f, 15 commits past the PR's base c4c515ad); nothing built, run or re-run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Public surface of `@object-ui/components` (`exports` is `.` only, `dist/index.d.ts` / `dist/index.js`, reached through `src/index.ts` to `custom/index.ts`): five names leave the entry. Runtime values `ViewSkeleton` and `ShimmerSkeleton`; types `ViewSkeletonVariant`, `ViewSkeletonDispatchProps`, `ShimmerSkeletonProps`. **Right**: these are exactly the five ruling B 6486367718 item (2) and amendment 6487017457 name; the retired set is a narrowing of the published accept-set, declared as such.
- `custom/index.ts` at the head keeps `export * from './view-skeleton'` and drops only the `shimmer-skeleton` line. **Right**: `GridSkeleton`, `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton`, `ChartSkeleton` and the `ViewSkeletonProps` / `GridSkeletonProps` / `KanbanSkeletonProps` types are still in the `export { ... }` block and the interfaces at the head of the file. `GridSkeleton` (DatasetWidget.tsx) and `ChartSkeleton` (ObjectChart.tsx, DatasetWidget.tsx, pinned by `chart-primitives-removed-7397.test.ts` `toContain('ChartSkeleton')`) keep their live importers.
- Importers of the five at the head, `git grep -w` over the whole tree excluding CHANGELOGs: only the changeset names them. On `origin/main` at 45c9be5f (15 commits past the PR base) the only hits are the two retired files themselves and the `styles.css` comment this PR rewords, so no importer appeared on `main` after the dev measured. **Right**: AGENTS.md step 4 (a removal that breaks `ui/` ships with the fix) has nothing to ship; `Type Check UI`, `Build & E2E UI`, `Test UI` (16/16 shards) and `Type Check · consumer gates` are green on the head.
- `data-slot="shimmer-skeleton"` leaves the DOM vocabulary. **Right**: no test, stylesheet or selector in the tree names it.
- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/styles.css`: comment-only hunk; `@keyframes shimmer` and `@utility animate-shimmer` stay. **Right**: `@object-ui/app-shell` is `private: true`, nothing publishes, and the utility is the migration target the changeset's `ShimmerSkeleton` FROM → TO line points an external host at, so keeping it is coherent. Observation, not a finding: after this PR nothing in the workspace carries `animate-shimmer`; the utility exists for hosts only.
- `scripts/sdui-manifest.record.json`: unchanged between the PR's base and the head (the 4-line delta against current `origin/main` is `main`'s own drift). **Right**: the record never names `components/src/custom`, `view-skeleton` or `shimmer`; the custom skeletons are outside the registry closure, so no manifest-hash token is owed.
- No governed path, no `packages/spec`, no metadata key: the queue guard (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success) and the dev's "not Tier H" reading agree with the file list. **Right**.
- Side effect the PR names as out of scope: `KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton` lose their only caller (the dispatcher) and stay exported. **Right per ruling**: amendment 6487017457 forbids widening the retirement (option B); carried as an out-of-scope finding on #25915 in report 6488314437.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `'@object-ui/components': patch`, body carries `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` and `Metadata-protocol: none` at line start, a `**BREAKING**` banner, one FROM → TO line for each of the five retired operands, and exactly one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired @object-ui/components#ViewSkeleton, ... #ShimmerSkeletonProps)`. The PR body carries the same two declaration lines (lines 6 and 7). **Matches** AGENTS.md Post-Task Checklist step 3: the level follows the protocol kind alone, `none` takes `patch`, and "a non-protocol change, widening or breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition". `Metadata-protocol: none` is correct: no key, accepted value or metadata type an author writes moves. `Check Changeset` (both runs) and `Lint & Repo Gates` are green on the head, so `check-adr-0087-registration` verified predicate 1 (retired-from-entry) for all five operands, predicate 2 (no metadata surface) and predicate 3 (FROM operands named), and `check-changeset-no-major` holds.
- `Clause-②: no (narrowing)` is the right arm: the accept-set of a published package shrinks and nothing is added; `(narrowing)` is BREAKING, which the `!` in the title and the banner both say. ADR-0145 does not apply, as the dev states and the ADR's own `Governs` line confirms: it covers `?: never` tombstones on the ui authoring face (`ui/packages/types` and published `.d.ts` keys), not React runtime exports; no tombstone is owed for a component.
- FROM → TO accuracy against the tree: `GridSkeletonProps` carries `columns`, `KanbanSkeletonProps` carries `columns` and `cardsPerColumn`, `FormSkeleton` / `ListSkeleton` take `ViewSkeletonProps`, `ShimmerSkeletonProps` aliased `React.HTMLAttributes` of a div — all true at the head. One nit in the dispatcher line: `ChartSkeleton` takes `Omit` of `rows`, so a host that passed `rows` with `variant: "chart"` gets a type error after migrating (the dispatcher used to forward `rows` onto the chart's root div as an unknown attribute). Prose face, should-fix at most, not blocking.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Report 6488314437 `open_questions`: none. Earlier open question 1 of 6487003112 (may slice 4 open as a narrowing, on what surface) was answered by amendment 6487017457 (option A, sequencing A); the diff is that option exactly, `styles.css` comment included.
- Deviation "no permanent absence pin; removal proven once on the built dist": accepted. The claim surface names no test file; the five are proven absent from the entry by `check-adr-0087-registration` predicate 1 while the changeset lives, and a re-introduction would be a new export owing its own `Clause-②: yes` declaration. Not escalated.
- Deviation "ui scripts/ gate recorded at its rerun after removing a stale local `ui/apps/site` directory": the CI check-runs on the head are the gate verdicts here (`Lint UI`, `Lint & Repo Gates`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` all success), so the local rerun carries nothing. Not escalated.
- Dev flag "`KanbanSkeleton`, `FormSkeleton`, `ListSkeleton` become uncalled exports": answered by the amendment (kept), carried as out-of-scope on the card. Not escalated; the seat owns whether a follow-up card is cut when #25915 closes.
- Check-runs on `8e055464`: 60 listed, all `completed`; conclusions are `success` or `skipped` (opt-in harnesses, matrix placeholders, schedule gate), none `failure`, none pending.
- Card closure: `Fixes #25915`. Ruling B item (1) landed as #27366 (`c4c515ad`), item (2) is this PR; the Studio panes and objectui#13386 are placed by the ruling. The `Fixes` is consistent with the dispatch order. Not escalated.

### ④ Design judgment

The narrowing, read against the published surface on `main` (`@object-ui/components` `exports` `.`, `src/index.ts`, `custom/index.ts`, the two source files) and the cited code:

- Does it take a declared capability away at the consumer? No. The capability (a variant-dispatching skeleton, and a shimmer variant of `Skeleton`) is removed at the producer, the package entry, not papered over at a call site. Every workspace consumer measured on `main` is zero, and the one surface that could call a skeleton by variant (`DatasetWidget.tsx`) already calls `GridSkeleton` / `ChartSkeleton` directly, which is what the FROM → TO prescribes. No published doc, skill or release note on `main` teaches `ViewSkeleton` or `ShimmerSkeleton` (`content/docs/**`, `skills/`, `.claude/skills/`, READMEs and every CHANGELOG read 0), so no declared promise outlives the code.
- Does it make a refusal real that the spec already made? Not applicable: these are React runtime exports with no `packages/spec` schema, registered node type or stored shape; the reader of a removed export is the compiler, which is the ADR-0087 D7 / `runtime-export-retired` argument the changeset makes and the gate verified.
- Implementation gap versus narrowing: the card body's own task line 3 says delete both "if still unused after the migration"; ruling B closed the migration at the Studio panes and left both at zero importers. Retiring them is the retire branch of "implemented or retired", not a consumer-side narrowing.
- Attempts to break it: (a) a third workspace package importing either name on `main` after the dev's measurement — none at 45c9be5f; (b) the removal breaking the `ChartSkeleton` barrel pin — the pin still passes (`Test UI` green), and the test's own message names `view-skeleton.tsx` as the file that legitimately stays; (c) the sdui registry closure moving — the record does not list the custom skeletons, so no hash moves; (d) the shimmer keyframe left orphaned — it stays by design as the host migration target; (e) the dispatcher silently forwarding `rows` to `ChartSkeleton`'s root div disappears with the dispatcher, a latent attribute leak removed rather than introduced.
- Findings: no must-fix. Should-fix (non-blocking, prose face): the dispatcher FROM → TO line says "each taking the same remaining props", which is one prop short for `variant: "chart"` (`rows` is refused there). Observation: `animate-shimmer` has no in-workspace consumer after this PR; a later card may retire it if the host-facing prescription ages out.
